expectationReview.firstVideoReason: The first head-template video visibly includes Face 16 after Face 12, so it cannot be described as covering only Face 1 through Face 12.
expectationReview.secondVideoReason: The second head-template video visibly includes Face 30 and Face 31 before ending on Face 29. Face 29 is not proven to be the final available head.
expectationReview.face12OverlapReason: Face 12 is selected near the end of video 002 and again at the beginning of video 003. It is one catalog identity with multiple evidence observations, not two records.

ambiguousEntries: Video 002 contains Face 16 despite the previous working-name expectation of Face 1 through Face 12.
Video 003 contains Face 30 and Face 31 despite the previous working-name expectation of Face 12 through Face 29.
Observed traversal is non-monotonic; native option numbers are preserved from visible labels, but full sequence/order continuity is incomplete.
Face 29 is not treated as the final available head because selector ending/wrap is not directly demonstrated.

selectorBoundaryProof.beginningProof: The first directly observed selected Head Template value in the current head footage is Face 1.
selectorBoundaryProof.endProof: The recording does not demonstrate the final selector boundary or a terminal no-more-options state.
selectorBoundaryProof.wrapProof: No selector wrap from final option back to first option is shown.
selectorBoundaryProof.face29FinalityReason: Face 30 and Face 31 are directly observed before the recording ends on Face 29, and no end or wrap behavior is shown.

sourceVideos.notes: Video 002 directly observes Face 1 and later Face 16; it is not a complete monotonic Face 1-12 sequence.
Video 003 begins on the overlapping Face 12 and ends with Face 29 selected after Face 30 and Face 31 were observed.

continuityReport.gapExplanation: Skipped numbers are not inferred as missing game options, unavailable options, or deleted options. They are only unresolved gaps in the currently observed selected sequence.
continuityReport.finalityConclusion: Face 29 is merely the final captured selected option in the current head-template footage, not the proven final Head Template option.
